newsitem.title: DENMARK: Mobilix Danish budgets 50 mln DKK for ad.
newsitem.headline: Mobilix Danish budgets 50 mln DKK for ad.

text.p: France Telecom's Danish unit, Mobilix, has budgeted 50 million crowns for advertising to launch its Danish mobile telephone service, the Danish advertising business journal Markedsfoering said on Thursday.

Markedsfoering said that agencies McCann-Erickson, Propaganda, Saatchi & Saatchi, Bates, Oglivy & Mather and Euro RSCG had been invited to pitch for the campaign account. Propaganda already handles Mobilix recruitment advertising.
Mobilix and Sweden's Telia were in March licensed to compete with Danish operators Tele Danmark and Sonofon in operating new DCS 1800 systems, a multi-operator refinement of existing GSM technology.
Mobilix is to start operating on January 1, next year.

An executive at Mobilix' PR agency Cohn & Wolfe confirmed that six agencies had been asked to submit ideas early in June and a decision would be made around the end of the month. She gave no further details. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650.
